name: WinterHeart
source:
This world is one override by the unending coldness of winter. Taken in by the temple a few years ago as a sacrifice, you eventually found yourself close to the end of time there as you prepared yourself a few days before you would be offered...

[From [url=https://leiphory.itch.io/winterheart]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一个被无尽寒冬所吞没的世界。几年前，你作为祭品被神殿收留；时光流转，在即将被献祭的前几天里，你一边做着最后的准备，一边意识到自己在此地的时日已然所剩无几……

[摘自[url=https://leiphory.itch.io/winterheart]itch.io[/url]]
